modes.title: Narrated explainer
modes.summary: A narrated 9:16 short built from code-animated text, charts, mockups and still images, timed to finalized narration and word timestamps.
use_when: educational lists, tips, myths versus facts and how-tos
comparisons, statistics, charts, timelines and processes
quotes, kinetic typography and UI or product mockups
any request that no specialised mode fits
not_for: stories that a specialised mode covers
AI-generated video, moving footage, screen recordings or talking heads (excluded in v1)

modes.title: Isometric zombie-apocalypse rules short
modes.summary: A narrated isometric horror story: a character escapes zombies and locks himself in, an emergency broadcast lists the rules for surviving the night, and an uncanny twist loops back to the opening shot.
use_when: a zombie or apocalypse survival story told in isometric miniature
horror "rules for surviving" shorts with an emergency-broadcast reveal
a new episode of this series: a different location, rules or twist
not_for: gore or graphic violence (the mode is uncanny, never gory)
horror outside the zombie-survival premise, such as hauntings or slashers
factual or educational content that merely mentions zombies
inputs: NVIDIA_NIM and ELEVENLABS keys for generation

new_mode_offer.ask_when: A person asked for this video in the conversation, and no specialised mode fits it, so it would fall back to the explainer. Ask once, before production starts.
new_mode_offer.ask_with: The OpenMausBot question card: the ask_user tool, or the engine's own AskUserQuestion tool.
new_mode_offer.question: No specialised video mode fits this request, so I would make it with the general explainer mode. If you will make more videos like this one, I can first build a dedicated mode for them: a short interview, a plan, then a sample for you to review after each build stage. How would you like to go?

choices.label: Just this video
choices.action: Make it with the explainer mode.

choices.label: New mode, then this video
choices.action: Interview, plan and build the new mode (skills/create-mode.md); make this video in it once it ships.

choices.label: New mode, and this video now
choices.action: Make this video with the explainer now, and build the new mode alongside it.

new_mode_offer.unattended: A job Showrunner dispatched without a person in the conversation never waits on this question: make it with the explainer and add a new-mode suggestion to the production report.
